comment: Independent do_wear.c witness for the touch test before putting on an accessory: the debug Healer polymorphs into a vampire, which hates silver, wishes a silver ring and puts it on. do_wear.c accessory_or_armor_on() calls artifact.c retouch_object() for every object, and its Hate_silver arm refuses the ring, burns the hero for rnd(10) and exercises Constitution; the put-on costs the turn.
